Suggested commit messages (pick one that best fits the change)
- chore: initial project import - feat: add Sinhvien model and Quanlysinhvien DB helper - refactor: move DB logic into Quanlysinhvien (OOP) - fix: correct cursor handling / close DB resources - docs: update README and push instructions - style: code formatting and linting - test: add unit tests for database operations - perf: optimize getAllSv query - ci: add CI workflow / GitHub Actions
Usage examples: - ./push_to_github.sh git@github.com:yourusername/your-repo.git main "feat: add Sinhvien and Quanlysinhvien" - Or: git commit -m "refactor: move DB logic into Quanlysinhvien (OOP)"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:id="@+id/main" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" tools:context=".MainActivity">
<!-- Old TextView for displaying student list (kept for reference) --> <!-- <TextView android:id="@+id/tvstudentlist" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Hello World!" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" /> -->
<!-- ScrollView to contain all content and make it scrollable --> <ScrollView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" android:fillViewport="true" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
<!-- LinearLayout to organize buttons and ListView vertically --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<!-- Title TextView for the Student Management System --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Student Management System" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:gravity="center" android:paddingBottom="16dp" android:textColor="@android:color/holo_blue_dark" />
<!-- Container for action buttons --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center" android:paddingBottom="16dp">
<!-- Button to add a new student --> <Button android:id="@+id/btnAddStudent" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Add Student" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" android:textSize="14sp" />
<!-- Button to refresh the student list --> <Button android:id="@+id/btnRefresh" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Refresh List" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" android:textSize="14sp" />
<!-- Button to delete all students --> <Button android:id="@+id/btnDeleteAll" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Delete All" android:textSize="14sp" android:backgroundTint="@android:color/holo_red_dark" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Info TextView to display instructions and selected item --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvInfo" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Tap to select • Long press to delete • Double tap to edit" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="italic" android:gravity="center" android:paddingBottom="8dp" android:textColor="@android:color/darker_gray" />
<!-- ListView to display the list of students --> <ListView android:id="@+id/lvStudentList" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="400dp" android:divider="@android:color/darker_gray" android:dividerHeight="1dp" android:choiceMode="singleChoice" android:background="@android:color/white" />
</LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
